title: MVN Group participates in the Re-launch ceremony of Golden Hills ecological urban Area
description: MVN Group proudly attended the Re-launch Ceremony of Golden Hills Ecological Urban Area and the Groundbreaking Ceremony of Khoi Nguyen Kindergarten in Da Nang, marking a new chapter in the project’s development and sustainable urban growth.
author: MVN Group
content:
On October 3, 2026, MVN Group was honored to attend the Re-launch Ceremony of the Golden Hills Ecological Urban Area Project and the Groundbreaking Ceremony of Khoi Nguyen Kindergarten in Da Nang, an event organized by KITA Group.
The event marked a new stage in the development of the Golden Hills project, while also raising expectations for the formation of a comprehensively planned and modern urban area, oriented toward quality of life and sustainable development values in Northwest Da Nang.

 

 

For MVN Group, being present at important events hosted by investors and partners in the industry is not only an opportunity to connect, but also a valuable occasion to exchange perspectives on architecture, construction, and urban development.
Through such networking and collaboration activities, MVN Group continues to focus on expanding its network of partners, while seeking opportunities to participate in projects with scale, quality, and long-term value for the urban environment.

 

 

MVN Group wishes KITA Group and the Golden Hills project a smooth and successful implementation, and hopes the project will gradually create sustainable values, contributing to a more modern, civilized, and livable urban landscape for Da Nang.
